entities.name: Drones
entities.description: Artificial guard and shock-troop beings created by the vedalken of Mirrodin.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Creators of the drones, masters of the Lumengrid.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: Slaves of the vedalken who disabled their drones at the Battle of the Synod.

entities.name: Battle of the Synod
entities.description: Battle in which Neurok disabled vedalken defenses.

entities.name: Mirran resistance
entities.description: Used hoverguards as spies against Phyrexians.

events.summary: At the Battle of the Synod the Neurok use stolen information to disable the vedalken drone defenses.
events.quote: the Neurok used information stolen from vedalken libraries to disable their wanderguard and hoverguard defenses

events.summary: The Mirran resistance uses hoverguards as spies against the Phyrexians.
events.quote: the Mirran resistance used hoverguards as spies against their Phyrexian enemies

relations.quote: Drones were living yet artificial beings created by the Vedalken of Mirrodin

relations.note: Neurok were enslaved and struck a decisive blow.
relations.quote: causing a decisive blow against the vedalken
